goal: Establish the canonical Component definition and execution model on the existing artifact-driven runtime without changing delivery architecture.
acceptance_criteria: Existing module contracts adapt to immutable PortSpec and ComponentSpec values without rewriting specs or flows.
ArtifactFlowCompiler and ArtifactModuleRunner both use the Component abstraction on one canonical execution path.
ComponentExecution safely records pass, fail, cache, and bypass lifecycle facts and projects them into checkpoints.
ArtifactRef, ArtifactInstance, and ArtifactStore remain the only canonical data and materialization model.
Compile-time port checks, runtime defensive validation, targeted tests, quick/profile, and kernel contract checks pass.

quality_metrics.method: code review plus runtime integration tests

quality_metrics.measure: runtime failures recorded as successful executions
quality_metrics.method: negative runtime and execution lifecycle tests

prevention: Adapt canonical module contracts instead of replacing them
Reuse ArtifactStore materialization, effect, cache, and fingerprint contracts
assurance: Run model tests before compiler/runtime integration tests
control: Run positive and negative Component lifecycle, compiler, runtime, and kernel contract tests
improvement: Record whether one execution truth removes checkpoint/feed divergence

interface_expectations: ComponentSpec is immutable and contains no run state
ComponentExecution binds run, node, component, artifact refs, cache, diagnostics, and timing
checkpoint and feed are projections of ComponentExecution
module implementation dispatch remains behind ModuleComponentAdapter

feedback: Component-specific and kernel contract verification passed 96 tests.
The formal quick profile timed out after 900 seconds with pre-existing failures in unrelated generated-component quality contracts.

worked: A thin Module adapter preserved existing specs, flows, ArtifactStore materialization, cache, and effects while moving compiler and runtime semantics to ComponentSpec.
ComponentExecution made checkpoint and feed rows projections of one lifecycle record.
did_not_work: The repository quick profile could not provide a clean regression signal because unrelated baseline contract assertions failed and the suite exceeded both 300 and 900 second limits.
experiments: Repair or rebaseline the unrelated generated-component quality contract before promoting PB-058 from needs_rework.
